title: Weighted L^2 bound for u - Du(x)x on a graph piece from the conical integral of V (step 4 of the rate proof)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (R ρ : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → u 0 = 0 → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) R, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ 1 / 7) → q '' graphOver u (ball 0 R) ⊆ ball 0 ρ → AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → (∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) R, g (q (graphPoint x (u x))) ≤ ∫⁻ y in q '' graphOver u (ball 0 R), g y ∂V.weight) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) R)), V.tangentProj (q (graphPoint x (u x))) = (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ u x v)))).starProjection) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) R, ENNReal.ofReal (‖u x - fderiv ℝ u x x‖ ^ 2 / ‖x‖ ^ (n + 2)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ (n + 4)) * ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Amb n ℓ) ρ, ENNReal.ofReal (‖y - V.tangentProj y y‖ ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂V.weight
